product_overview: Code Ruler learns coding rules from GitHub PR reviews, presents them in a UI, and generates/enforces linter checks. The backend exposes APIs for repository and rule management, provenance, enforcer and video generation, statistics, credential checks, and pipeline job orchestration.
core_goals: Discover coding rules from GitHub PR review comments and surface them to users
Provide provenance linking rules back to PRs, authors, diffs, and file paths
Generate reproducible enforcer scripts (linters) from extracted rules and surface execution/tracing data
Run durable background pipelines to fetch PRs and extract rules at scale with resumable workflows
Provide lightweight media previews (animated videos) for rules and operational statistics
Offer service connectivity checks for external dependencies (Bedrock/Minimax, Datadog, GitHub)

features.name: Repository Management
features.description: List all repositories tracked by the system along with counts of extracted rules per repository.
user_flows: GET /api/repos -> Receive 200 with RepoItem[] containing repo metadata and rule counts
GET /api/repos -> Receive 200 with an empty RepoItem[] when no repositories are tracked
GET /api/repos -> Receive 500 when the server encounters an internal error

features.name: Rule Management
features.description: List and inspect extracted coding rules with support for repository scoping, filtering, searching, and a detailed view including decorator and linter source.
user_flows: GET /api/rules?repo_id=1&category=best_practice&severity=medium&is_active=true&search=variable_name -> Receive 200 with RuleListItem[] matching filters
GET /api/rules?repo_id=1 -> Receive 200 with RuleListItem[] for repo 1 -> GET /api/rules/example-rule-slug?repo_id=1 -> Receive 200 with RuleDetail including decorator and linter source
GET /api/rules -> Receive 400 when repo_id is missing but required by the endpoint
GET /api/rules/nonexistent-slug -> Receive 404 Rule not found

features.name: Rule Provenance
features.description: Show provenance information for a rule: the PR reviews that generated it, including comment authors, diff hunks and file paths.
user_flows: GET /api/rules/example-rule-slug/provenance -> Receive 200 with ProvenanceItem[] listing PR references, authors, diffs, and file paths
GET /api/rules/example-rule-slug/provenance -> Receive 404 when the requested rule is not found

features.name: Enforcer Management
features.description: Generate AST-based enforcer scripts (linter checks) for rules, list generated enforcers, and retrieve enforcer details including source, tests, and traces.
user_flows: POST /api/rules/example-rule-slug/generate-enforcer -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse containing job_id -> GET /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id} -> Receive 200 with JobStatusResponse showing progress -> GET /api/enforcers?repo_id=1 -> Receive 200 with EnforcerListItem[] including the generated enforcer -> GET /api/rules/example-rule-slug/enforcer -> Receive 200 with EnforcerDetail including source, tests, and traces
POST /api/rules/example-rule-slug/generate-enforcer -> Receive 400 when the rule has no negative_example and generation cannot proceed
POST /api/rules/example-rule-slug/generate-enforcer -> Receive 409 when enforcer generation is already in progress for this rule
POST /api/rules/nonexistent-slug/generate-enforcer -> Receive 404 Rule not found
GET /api/rules/example-rule-slug/enforcer -> Receive 404 when the rule or enforcer is not found

features.name: Video Generation
features.description: Create animated video previews for rules using the Minimax API and poll for task status.
user_flows: POST /api/rules/example-rule-slug/generate-video with body {"prompt":"Show how the rule transforms code"} -> Receive 200 with VideoResponse containing task_id -> GET /api/video/{task_id} -> Receive 200 with VideoResponse status 'processing' or 'completed' and video URL when ready
POST /api/rules/example-rule-slug/generate-video -> Receive 404 Rule not found
GET /api/video/{task_id} -> Receive 200 with VideoResponse status 'failed' and error details when Minimax returns an error

features.name: Statistics
features.description: Provide summary statistics about extracted rules and processed PRs, with optional scoping to a repository and breakdowns by category and severity.
user_flows: GET /api/stats -> Receive 200 with StatsResponse containing global counts and breakdowns by category and severity
GET /api/stats?repo_id=1 -> Receive 200 with StatsResponse scoped to repo 1
GET /api/stats?repo_id=9999 -> Receive 200 with StatsResponse showing zeroed counts when the repo has no processed data or Receive 400 for an invalid repo_id parameter

features.name: Credentials Check
features.description: Check connectivity to external services (AWS Bedrock / Anthropic, Datadog, GitHub) and report status per integration.
user_flows: GET /api/credentials/status -> Receive 200 with CredentialsStatusResponse showing success for Bedrock, Datadog, and GitHub when all connections succeed
GET /api/credentials/status -> Receive 200 with CredentialsStatusResponse showing per-service failures (e.g., Bedrock: unreachable) when some integrations fail
GET /api/credentials/status -> Receive 500 when the credentials check subsystem encounters an unexpected error

features.name: Pipeline Jobs
features.description: Start and manage background pipeline jobs to extract PRs and rules (full and quick modes), resume/cancel DBOS workflows, poll job status and step-level progress, and get per-repo processing statistics.
user_flows: POST /api/pipeline/extract-prs with body {"repo_url":"https://github.com/org/repo","limit":100} -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse containing job_id -> GET /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id} -> Receive 200 with JobStatusResponse showing 'running' or 'completed' -> GET /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id}/steps -> Receive 200 with PipelineEvent[] describing step progress

POST /api/pipeline/extract-rules with body {"limit":500,"dry_run":false,"repo_full_name":"org/repo"} -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse -> GET /api/pipeline/jobs -> Receive 200 with JobStatusResponse[] listing recent pipeline jobs

POST /api/pipeline/quick-fetch-prs with body {"repo_url":"https://github.com/org/repo","limit":10} -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse -> POST /api/pipeline/quick-extract-rules with body {"limit":10,"repo_filter":"org/repo"} -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse -> POST /api/pipeline/quick-run with body {"repo_url":"https://github.com/org/repo","pr_limit":10} -> Receive 200 with JobStartResponse
GET /api/pipeline/repo-stats -> Receive 200 with RepoStatsResponse[] showing processed/unprocessed comment counts per repo
GET /api/pipeline/jobs/nonexistent-job -> Receive 404 Job not found
POST /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id}/resume -> Receive 400 when DBOS is not enabled or no workflow exists to resume
POST /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id}/resume -> Receive 404 Job not found when job_id is invalid

POST /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id}/cancel -> Receive 200 with status 'cancelled' when the workflow is cancelled -> GET /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id} -> Receive 200 with JobStatusResponse showing status 'cancelled'
POST /api/pipeline/jobs/{job_id}/cancel -> Receive 404 Job not found when job_id is invalid
